category_title: Students experiencing sensory overload and avoidance behaviors due to trauma
scenario_title: Receiving feedback on a logic-based paper
minimal_context: Natasha is reviewing a returned logic-based paper in front of her English class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Natasha, here is your returned paper. You missed the point on the logic section of this assignment, so please review the corrections.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts doodling and drawing on the paper) I have zero concentration right now. It is hard to do something like school that's logic when you don't have any logic left.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please stop drawing and look at the feedback. We are going over this in front of the class so everyone can see where they went wrong.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looking jittery and restless) I can't do this right now. Something as simple as being in class is just too hard.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to focus on the academic task. Look at the paper and try to figure out the logic.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up, looking overwhelmed and on the verge of tears) I need to physically dismiss myself. I'm going to the girls' bathroom.

task.content: Reviewing a returned paper where she 'missed the point' on a logic-based academic task

context.social_setting: In front of the whole class

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When confronted publicly and singled out about missing the point on the paper
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Physically leaving class ('physically dismiss myself') to find a safe place in the girls' bathroom
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Experienced significant humiliation, anxiety, and distress, feeling overwhelmed and on the verge of tears
related_quotes: never bother people in front of the whole class—I think that's the worst.

behavior_patterns.condition: When attempting to manage restlessness and lack of concentration during classroom instruction
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Doodling and drawing in an effort to distract herself

behavior_patterns.condition: When feeling overwhelmed or on the verge of tears
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Leaving class and often not returning, spending considerable time sitting on the counter in the girls' bathroom
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Driven by a need to find a place where she felt safe
related_quotes: something as simple as being in class was just too hard
